journey.name: Sync and Content Journey
journey.description: Verify active hours refresh scheduling, HTML image parsing & URL sanitation, and toggling show/dim/hide read articles via header filter button

actions.action: Select active refresh schedule "08:00 – 20:00 (Work hours)" from the active hours spinner
Verify widget displays articles with thumbnail images parsed from feed content
Verify the read filter button is displayed next to the refresh button on the widget header
Tap an article to mark it as read
Tap the read filter button to switch to Dim mode and verify read item is dimmed
Tap the read filter button again to switch to Hide mode and verify read item is hidden
Tap the read filter button again to switch back to Show mode and verify read item reappears
Reopen widget settings and verify active refresh schedule remains preserved
